sentences.text: Black Sails is an American historical adventure television series set on New Providence Island and a prequel to Robert Louis Stevenson 's novel Treasure Island .	historical	Historical period drama	adventure	Adventure fiction	television series	television series	New Providence	New Providence	Robert Louis Stevenson	Robert Louis Stevenson	Treasure Island	Treasure Island
The series was created by Jonathan E. Steinberg and Robert Levine for Starz .	Jonathan E. Steinberg	Jonathan E. Steinberg	Starz	Starz (TV channel)
It debuted online for free on YouTube and other various streaming platform and video on demand services on January 18 , 2014 .	YouTube	YouTube
The debut on cable television followed a week later on January 25 , 2014 .

Steinberg is executive producer , alongside Michael Bay , Brad Fuller and Andrew Form , while Michael Angeli , Doris Egan , and Levine are co-executive producers .	Michael Bay	Michael Bay	Brad Fuller	Bradley Fuller	Andrew Form	Andrew Form	Michael Angeli	Michael Angeli	Doris Egan	Doris Egan
On July 26 , 2013 , Starz renewed the show for a ten-episode second season , which premiered on January 24 , 2015 .	Starz	Starz (TV channel)

The early renewal , six months before the first season premiered , was based on the positive fan reaction to the show at the San Diego Comic-Con .	San Diego Comic-Con	San Diego Comic-Con International
The series was renewed for a third season on October 12 , 2014 , and a fourth season on July 31 , 2015 , both before the respective previous seasons had premiered .

On July 20 , 2016 , Starz announced that the series ' fourth season would be its last ; the season premiered on January 29 , 2017 , and the series concluded on April 2 , 2017 .	Starz	Starz (TV channel)
